title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting homemade chicken noodle soup with tender chicken thighs, carrots, celery and egg noodles in a savory broth.

image.alt: A bowl of chicken noodle soup with carrots, celery and parsley

steps.text: Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery until softened, {time 8 min}. Add the garlic for {time 1 min}.
Add the broth, chicken thighs, thyme, bay leaf and salt. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer gently, partly covered, until the chicken is cooked through, {time 20-25 min}.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks. Remove the bay leaf.
Bring the soup back to a boil, add the noodles and cook until tender, {time 6-8 min}. Return the chicken to the pot.
Stir in the parsley and lemon juice, then taste and add more salt if needed.

notes: Noodles soften and swell in leftovers. For meal prep, cook them separately and add to each bowl.
The soup (without noodles) freezes well for up to 3 months.
